label.en: Rise above the storm or shelter in the cave

note.zh: 2700 的两个选项开启两条平行但互不相交的线索：风之线（2705 → 2715 → 2725）与真菌洞穴线（2710 → 2720 → 2730），随后汇合到相同的四种结局。
note.en: The two options of 2700 open two separate lines: the wind line (2705 → 2715 → 2725) and the fungal cave line (2710 → 2720 → 2730), which then converge on the same four outcomes.

note.zh: 在 2745 / 2750 中选择：加固风（花 25 合金，难度 −3 → 2755）、滋养真菌（花 50 矿物，难度 −3 → 2760）、协商折衷（非狂暴灭绝者 → 2765）或灭绝两者（狂暴灭绝者 → 2770）。2730.a 可直接以 50 矿物保护生态系统（→ 2760）。
note.en: Chosen in 2745 / 2750: fortify the wind (25 alloys, difficulty −3 → 2755), nourish the fungus (50 minerals, difficulty −3 → 2760), negotiate (non-homicidal → 2765) or eradicate both (homicidal → 2770). 2730.a protects the ecosystem directly for 50 minerals (→ 2760).

note.zh: 解锁培育风生物的能力（可授权三只）；演化猎手起源另得真菌 DNA；探索结束。
note.en: Unlocks incubating wind creatures (three authorized); Evolutionary Predators also get fungoid DNA; the exploration ends.

note.zh: 标本“超维真菌”与“高维孢子”修正；演化猎手起源另得鸟类 DNA；探索结束。
note.en: Specimen “extradimensional fungus” and the Extra-Dimensional Spores modifier; Evolutionary Predators also get avian DNA; the exploration ends.

note.zh: 该星球获得+10社会研究矿藏、奇异气体、能量与大量星界丝缕；格式塔帝国另得团结；探索结束。非格式塔帝国两天后有领袖事件。
note.en: The planet gains a +10 society deposit, exotic gases, energy and many astral threads; gestalt empires also get unity. The exploration ends; non-gestalt empires get a leader event two days later.

note.zh: 两个物种都被消灭：食物、凝聚力与大量星界丝缕；探索结束。
note.en: Both species are wiped out: food, unity and a large astral thread reward; the exploration ends.

label.en: A Special Request: the scientist asks for a new duty

note.zh: 尾声：促成协议的科学家请求转为使节（获得“再转换领袖”修正）或留任。
note.en: Coda: the scientist who brokered the agreement asks to become an envoy (gaining Reconverted Leader) or stays.

notes.zh: 抽取权重 1，无条件；不产出遗珍，没有失败分支（00_astral_rifts.txt:355-364）。
notes.en: Draw weight 1, no conditions; no relic and no failure branch (00_astral_rifts.txt:355-364).

notes.zh: 2750 的第四个选项与 2745 共用同一选项键 astral_rift.2745.d（events/astral_rifts_2_events.txt:3660），所以编译图把两处都标成同一个键。
notes.en: The fourth option of 2750 reuses the option key astral_rift.2745.d (events/astral_rifts_2_events.txt:3660), so the compiled graph shows the same key on both.

scope.zh: 已核对裂隙定义与 2700–2790 全部事件、资源门槛、选项条件与奖励。
scope.en: Checked the rift definition and every event 2700–2790 with resource gates, option conditions and rewards.
